description.value: Ridge Garden is a Chinese restaurant in Vancouver's Arbutus Ridge neighbourhood, situated near the ICBC office on Macdonald Street. The restaurant offers dine-in service and has recently reopened its dining room, making it a sit-down meal option for cyclists moving through this quieter residential corridor of the city.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the restaurant is open for dine-in at 4009 Macdonald Street, Vancouver, BC V6L 2N9, matching the OSM address. The OSM phone number (604-736-7006) appears as Line 2 on the website, which also lists a primary Line 1 (604-736-5231) not in OSM. No cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM records only one phone number (604-736-7006, listed as Line 2 on the website); the website also lists a primary Line 1: (604) 736-5231, which is absent from OSM.
Website URL was auto-discovered at medium confidence and is not present in OSM tags — worth verifying ownership.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is confirmed open and legitimately serves the public, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website content. Direct outreach is needed before listing.
